answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding identities to bonded collateral and applying joint fault attribution. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting statements, the penalty scales as O(k^2); once a controlled swarm is detected, an exponential multiplier applies to aggregate capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation and escrow forfeiture. Splitting stake among falcon, nebula, and fable identities therefore cannot lower expected cost, because correlation links their liabilities.
